loads.name: Reactor auxiliaries, port
loads.under: Two full trains (port and starboard): the reactor scrams when neither train has had 80% of its supply for 2 s. Ignition runs at the pace the two trains' supply allows.

loads.name: Reactor auxiliaries, starboard
loads.under: As the port half.

loads.name: Coolant pump A
loads.under: Its setpoint is its speed; the speed it runs at is the one its supply allows. Loop flow falls in proportion; each pump is half the flow.
loads.over: Up to 120% speed: 1.2 times its flow for 1.44 times its power, with heat and wear (reactor-cooling design 6).

loads.name: Coolant pump B
loads.under: As pump A.

loads.name: Radiator pump, port
loads.under: Its setpoint is its speed. Radiator rejection falls in proportion; each pump is half the radiators' flow (reactor-cooling design 2).

loads.name: Radiator pump, starboard
loads.under: As the port pump.

loads.name: Coolant makeup pump
loads.under: Makeup flow from the tanks in proportion to supply.

loads.name: Emergency lighting
loads.under: Below 50%: compartments with no normal lighting go dark.

loads.name: Computer core
loads.under: Automation competence falls with supply; below 50% every automated station stops and targeting solutions are lost.
loads.over: Automation reaction time shortens by up to a third.

loads.name: Bridge consoles
loads.under: Below 50%: the bridge stations go dark; the engineering bay console and the damage control board still work.

loads.name: Oxygen generator
loads.under: Oxygen output in proportion to supply.
loads.over: Output up to 1.5 times rated, with heat and wear.

loads.name: CO2 scrubbers
loads.under: CO2 and smoke removal in proportion to supply.

loads.name: Air handler fans
loads.under: Circulation in proportion to supply; below 20% the fans stop and every vent damper springs shut.

loads.name: Thermal control
loads.under: Cabin cooling and heating in proportion to supply.

loads.name: Medbay beds
loads.under: Healing and revival in proportion to supply; below 25% the beds stop.

loads.name: Shield generator
loads.under: Face regeneration and capacity in proportion to supply; below 25% the faces collapse.
loads.over: Regeneration up to 1.5 times, with heat.

loads.name: Dorsal turret
loads.under: Capacitor charge rate in proportion to supply (4 MW nominal against 6 MW of sustained fire); below 20% it cannot fire.
loads.over: Up to 1.5 times the rate of fire, with heat.

loads.name: Ventral turret
loads.under: As the dorsal turret.

loads.name: Port turret
loads.under: As the dorsal turret.

loads.name: Starboard turret
loads.under: As the dorsal turret.

loads.name: Sensor array
loads.under: Active range grows as the square root of supply; at standby only passive contacts.
loads.over: Range up to 1.22 times (square root of 1.5).

loads.name: Inertial dampers
loads.under: The share of the ship's acceleration the crew feel is 1 minus supply/demand; past 0.5 g felt, crew are knocked down.
loads.over: Absorbs manoeuvres up to 1.5 times the rated acceleration.

loads.name: Gravity generator
loads.under: Gravity in g equals supply ratio; below 30% the field drops to zero (free fall).
loads.over: Up to 1.25 g: crew move 10% slower.

loads.name: Impulse drive
loads.under: Thrust in proportion to supply.
loads.over: Up to 1.5 times rated thrust, with heat and wear.

loads.name: RCS, aft block
loads.under: Turn rate in proportion to the weaker block's supply.

loads.name: RCS, forward block
loads.under: As the aft block.

loads.name: Missile hoist and loaders
loads.under: Reload time grows as 1/supply; unpowered, crew load by hand crank (weapons-and-shields).

loads.name: Tube 1 loader
loads.under: Its tube loads and fires only while the loader works (ship-damage 4).

loads.name: Tube 2 loader
loads.under: As tube 1.

loads.name: Laser bank, port
loads.under: Charges its 150 MJ capacitor at 5 MW times supply (laser-banks 1); damaged, at its capability (ship-damage 4).

loads.name: Laser bank, starboard
loads.under: As the port bank.

loads.name: Comms array
loads.under: Range in proportion to supply; below 20% only short-range voice.

loads.name: Bay pumps
loads.under: Pumping speed in proportion to supply.

loads.name: Airlock pump
loads.under: Pumping speed in proportion to supply.

loads.name: Port launch cradle
loads.under: Release charge time grows as 1/supply.

loads.name: Starboard launch cradle
loads.under: As the port cradle.

loads.name: Shuttle lift pad
loads.under: Lift speed in proportion to supply.

groups.name: Cooling
groups.note: reactor-cooling design 6: the twelfth group, 2.05 MW at full speed. Its setpoint is the pumps' speed, 0-120% (120% is overdrive). Its loads are priority 0 (never shed) by default, and priority_min 0 lets engineering lower them to 1-3 and back, which lets load shedding take them. feed_breaker: one breaker on the group's feed, opened or locked open from the console; open, it stops every pump in the group and the loop falls to its natural circulation.

presets.note: Setpoints by group (1.0 is nominal; 0 switches the group off; above 1 is overdrive). Groups not named keep 1.0. Automated engineering applies combat on red alert and cruise on its end (bridge-stations).

distribution.note: power-routing design 1: tools/power/boxes.py places a conduit box in every room without a switchboard or panel, beside the doorway its feed comes in by, box_height_m over the floor and box_into_room_m off the wall; runs go run_below_ceiling_m under the ceiling (or under the next deck in a taller room). A feed run's rating is its rooms' most (every load at its setpoint_max, the lights) times rating_margin, rounded up to ratings_mw; a spare run takes spare_mw or the larger feed rating of its two rooms.

routing.note: power-routing design 2: a run (conduit or tie) is live when it is closed, not severed and both its nodes are switched on. The main protection allows max_live_runs at once (the factory configuration is 39); one more trips the grid: every node but the kinds in kept_on_trip is switched off and every run opened for trip_dark_s, then every switch returns to its factory setting. The owner, 2026-10-11: "Too many conduits open can cause the ship to shut down temporarily and reset the configuration to factory settings".

coolant.design_flow_note: 40 MW at a 15 K rise in water and glycol (3.6 kJ/kg K); the console shows flow as this times the flow fraction
coolant.segments_note: reactor-cooling design 1-2: the loop's eight pipe segments, numbered from the core along the flow (the hot leg from the core to the chiller, the cold leg from the chiller back to the core). Each is a part with integrity (damage.json coolant). A leg carries flow x its worst segment's capability; an isolated segment carries nothing and its leg runs through the bypass jumper round it at isolated_leg_flow.
coolant.cooling_note: reactor-cooling design 2, 3, 5 and 6. Speed-law loads (power_exponent) draw nominal_mw x speed^power_exponent, their standby_mw unused, and run at the speed their supply allows. flow = max(natural_circulation_flow, core pumps' speed x capability x flow_per_pump, summed, x cavitation); cavitation = clamp((m_loop / inventory_kg - no_flow_below) / (full_flow_from - no_flow_below), 0, 1). C_loop = capacity_mj_per_k x m_loop / inventory_kg. Hot leg = loop temperature + heat into the loop / (flow x design_flow_kg_s x specific heat); it is the one the loop scram reads. Radiator rejection gains the exchanger's capability and the radiator pumps' speed x capability x flow_per_radiator_pump, summed. Automation every period_s: core pumps at the flow the heat needs at design_rise_k, never below pump_speed_min (the mockup keeps power-grid's full-flow walkthroughs), up to 1.2; radiator pumps at full; the bypass holds the cold leg by radiators.bypass_band_k (325-330 K, design 5's 327 K); makeup opens below auto_open_below and shuts at full. Pipe segments, leaks and the exchanger's damage (design 1-2): flow gains x min over the two legs of the leg's factor (its worst segment's capability, or isolated_leg_flow x the worst of the rest when one is isolated); the exchanger's capability is its integrity's (damage.json systems); segments and tanks leak by damage.json coolant.

radiators.law: capacity = rated_mw * health * flow * exchanger * radiator_pumps * (T^4 - Tb^4) / (rated_at_k^4 - Tb^4); rejected = capacity * chiller, where chiller (the share of the hot leg through the exchanger) is clamp((T - (coolant.nominal_k - bypass_band_k)) / bypass_band_k, 0, 1) in AUTO and the engineer's in MANUAL; exchanger and radiator_pumps as coolant.cooling_note (reactor-cooling design 2)
radiators.note: Fictional rating, stated as such: a physical radiator rejecting 40 MW at 330 K would need about 60,000 m^2. See design.md, Heat, and open question P4.
